title: Where on Earth
blurb: Capitals, borders and place names that trip up even keen travellers.

prompts.text: The capital of Turkey is _____, not Istanbul.

Switzerland's capital is _____, not Zurich or Geneva.

Liechtenstein and _____ are the only two doubly landlocked countries.
